description: Each line is a JSON object representing one 60-second livestream clip.

session_id.description: Anonymous session identifier, for same-session exclusion in retrieval

asr_text.description: ASR transcript of host speech within the 60s clip

visual_caption.description: Visual-semantic caption generated by Qwen3.5-9B from sampled frames

comment_text.description: Audience comments within the clip, serialized in temporal order

propagation_seq.description: 12 windows × 6 features: [n, d, q, delta_P, rho_P, I_P]

rationale.description: Optional annotation rationale identifying primary supporting evidence
